sources.photos: Owner originals IMG_0852-0853 (2026-10-29), IMG_0967-0968 and IMG_0971 (2026-10-31), IMG_1084-1085 (2026-11-01), inspected locally at original resolution. Private references; no pixels are shipped or used as textures.
sources.streetViewUse: Viewed in Google Maps on 2026-11-02 under Google's terms. No imagery downloaded into the project.

verified: Tall gate pillars are recessed from the long street frontage. Concave quarter-circle returns open toward the forecourt and join the two frontage types to the pillars. The owner corrected the earlier convex interpretation on 2026-11-02.
A smaller stone end post marks each transition to the straight frontage. The south return shelters the orange round postbox.
The postbox has a shallow domed cap, raised collars, a hooded slot over a round postal badge, a lower collection door and side paper labels.
limits: Mapped source junction and photo-relative placements are separate. Inset, radius, pillar spacing, box size and fine details are visual estimates, not a measured survey. Street View predates the temporary office and current notices. Collection times and current rules are not asserted.
